description: Breadcrumbs provide a group of links so users can easily navigate a website's hierarchy. Breadcrumbs are usually placed before a page’s main content with the current page shown last to indicate the user’s position in the navigation.
title: Default

description: By default, breadcrumb items are rendered as buttons so you can use them to navigate single-page applications. In this case, you’ll need to add event listeners to handle clicks.For websites, you’ll probably want to use links instead. You can make any breadcrumb item a link by applying an href attribute to it. Now, when the user activates it, they’ll be taken to the corresponding page — no event listeners required.
title: Breadcrumb Links

description: Use the prefix slot to add content before any breadcrumb item.
title: Prefixes

description: Use the suffix slot to add content after any breadcrumb item.
title: Suffixes

description: Dropdown menus can be placed in a prefix or suffix slot to provide additional options.
title: With Dropdowns
